description: Miro is an online collaborative whiteboard and visual workspace platform for creating boards, diagrams, and team planning artifacts. It provides APIs and AI-agent connectivity for working with Miro boards and related content.
summary: Miro exposes a REST API at `https://api.miro.com/v2` authenticated with OAuth 2.0 app credentials and a public streamable-HTTP MCP server at `https://mcp.miro.com/`.
